verdict.rationale: The README documents a first-party CLI command, `edge0 serve edge0-35b`, that starts a local OpenAI-compatible server reachable at 127.0.0.1:8000. The macOS build is described as a local CLI/daemon, which supports command-line server management. Missing for 10: any documented stop or shutdown command or daemon lifecycle controls (stop is only implied by a foreground process), server flags such as port or host, and independent hands-on corroboration.
